note.es: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Gas natural sin cargos de servicio ni reparto, con la rebaja provincial descontada, CAD por gigajulio. Serie mensual en dolares canadienses.
note.en: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Natural gas excluding service and delivery charges, with the provincial rebate deducted, CAD per gigajoule. Monthly series in Canadian dollars.

note.it: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Gas naturale senza oneri di servizio e distribuzione, con lo sconto provinciale detratto, CAD per gigajoule. Serie mensile in dollari canadesi.
